results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller-supplied `to` (recipient address), `tokenId` (sequential ticket ID), `from` (expected current owner), and `msg.sender` (authenticated via `_msgSender()` as `auth`) reach `Raffle._update` and `ERC721._update`, which clear `_tokenApprovals[tokenId]`, decrement `_balances[previousOwner]`, increment `_balances[to]`, write `_owners[tokenId] = to`, and emit `Transfer(previousOwner, to, tokenId)`.
results.flow_security_relevance: `Raffle._update` allows bearer ticket ownership (`_owners[tokenId]`) to be transferred in any raffle lifecycle state (`Active`, `Drawing`, `NftWon`, `CashWon`, or `Refunding`), including after `settleWinningTicket` has already recorded `winningTicketId`. Because `redeemWinningTicket` and `refundTickets` authorize claims solely via `ownerOf(ticketId)` while `_ticketRanges[tokenId]` remains fixed, transferring a ticket immediately reassigns the right to claim the escrowed prize NFT, cash-winner USDC proceeds, or USDC entry refunds. Additionally, unlike `safeTransferFrom`, `transferFrom` does not invoke `onERC721Received` on `to`, so tickets can be transferred to arbitrary non-protocol contract addresses without verifying receiver capability.
results.flow_summary: An authorized caller (current ticket owner, per-ticket approved address, or operator) transfers bearer ownership of an existing, unburned raffle ticket `tokenId` from `from` to a non-zero, non-protocol recipient address `to`. The flow screens `to` against known protocol plumbing via `Raffle._isProtocolDestination` (including staticcalls to `RaffleFactory.raffleImplementation()` and `RaffleFactory.isRaffle(to)`), verifies caller authorization against the current ticket owner, clears any single-ticket approval, updates `_balances` and `_owners[tokenId] = to`, emits `Transfer`, and verifies that the previous owner matches `from`.
results.flow_terminal_action: Mutates ERC-721 ticket storage (`_tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0)`, `_balances[previousOwner] -= 1`, `_balances[to] += 1`, `_owners[tokenId] = to`) and emits `Transfer(previousOwner, to, tokenId)` in `ERC721._update`, then verifies `previousOwner == from` in `ERC721.transferFrom`.
